Because she is alone, she pours all her energy into work.
Because she is lonely, her boss becomes her emotional pillar.

He is a good looking but bad-tempered ice skating athlete. He has the meanest mouth, but when she is in trouble, he is the one who dashes to her aid without reservations. Spaces tremble violently and dimensional cracks connected to various worlds appear! In an instant, never-seen-before civilizations invade our homeland. Insects the size of humans and walking corpses sweep through Earth in legions. An imminent crisis is approaching humanity and billions of human lives are at risk!

Under the lingering shadow of death, he vows to prevent a repeat of past tragedies!

Walking hand in hand with death, he no longer lives under the cold embrace of the darkness. He shall embark on the bright path towards glory.

14890.synopsis:
Endless Continent, limitless and boundless. On the Continent where the imperial stood, the imperial is supreme!
An unexpected accident during an archaeology expedition causes Su Yu to cross over to Endless Continent. His spirit gets attached to a young man who was buried in the life and death forbidden domain. After which, he walks out of that domain and towards an unfamiliar world.

16682.synopsis:
As part of the imperial family, every move by Chu Yuan in this game of chess is made with apprehension, fearing that with a moment of inattentiveness, the whole match will be lost in a single move.
Ascending to the throne at eighteen, not half a year passes before civil strife erupts in Yun Nan. Though the thoughts of the old guard at the imperial court are not exactly identical, they are all waiting to see how the new emperor will put an end to this.
Unexpectedly, before this side could make a move, a few thousand miles away, the King of Xi Nan, Duan Bai Yue, had already personally commanded troops to attack in all directions; not half a year had passed when peace was restored.
Sparse moonlight shines into the palace; Chu Yuan stamped the wax seal himself, and had a secret letter sent urgently to Yun Nan 800 miles away — this time, what must we(1) give in exchange?
Brush marks passed through the back of the paper; it almost can be seen, when writing this line, how angry the young emperor was.
Duan Bai Yue spread out a piece of paper unhurriedly, replying with only one word.
You.
Note (1): Chu Yuan is using the royal ‘we’ here.
The Emperor’s Strategy is the fourth book in Yu Xiao Lan Shan’s Jianghu/Strategy series. Each book is standalone, but there are character cameos and mentions that don’t disrupt the flow of the main story of each book.
1st book: Everywhere in Jianghu is Wonderful
2nd book: The Jianghu is Full of Local Tyrants
3rd book: The Bandit’s Strategy
4th book: The Emperor’s Strategy
5th book: Return Together

19498.synopsis:
After receiving his terminal illness diagnosis, Chu Xun could finally let go of everything. The most important thing of being alive is after all, one’s own happiness.
Dumping a jerk, getting back at his as*hole colleagues, firing his dumbass boss, staying in a luxurious house, enjoying a feast and bedding a young, energetic and handsome guy—Chu Xun very coolly did what he didn’t dare to do in the past!

“…” Chu Xun felt faint.
He did another checkup and thought, he did feel unwell recently though?
The doctor looked grim.
Chu Xun’s heart skipped a beat. “Don’t tell me it wasn’t a misdiagnosis after all. Am I sick?”
Doctor: “You do not have a terminal illness, but you are… You are pregnant.”
Chu Xun: “???” Ermm, he’s a guy?
And later, the child’s father, that young, energetic and handsome man, who also happened to be a 26-year-old billionaire, Lin Yanchen, appeared and handed out a marriage certificate already signed by him. “I’ll take responsibility. Let’s get married.”

21034.synopsis:
“Hey, Yoshi-kun. I think you’re——”

And then in the empty lot where the white cat slept. Shiina Yuki, the strange girl who somehow knew all about me, always approached me like that.
We laughed, cried, got angry, held hands. Again and again, we repeated those disappearing memories and ephemeral promises. That’s why I never knew. I never knew the value of Yuki’s smiles or the meaning of her tears. Nor even the singular sentiment behind her many ‘Nice to meet you’s.

In the capital city, the eldest daughter of the Tang family’s main bloodline, Tang Zhuo Zhuo, lavishly married into the Eastern Palace. Yet, she chose to spend her remaining years within the broken walls of the Cold Palace’s courtyard.

Whilst the general had married the girl of his dreams from the start. 
Who would have imagined that the scene that greeted her when she opened her eyes again was the event that happened when she first entered the Eastern Palace – where she grimaced in displeasure towards the future Chong Jian Emperor. 
The male’s face whitened with fury.

Huo Qiu had an uncanny feeling. His wife, who had rejected him so severely before, seemingly changed into a new person. Not only did she not create any disturbances, but also made him some pastries.

My little sister loves me so much that it’s scary… no, seriously. My sister—Akari Namiki, is definitely a very charming girl. She’s got wits, she’s got beauty, she’s got style. But just look at me, I’m just some extra-ordinary mob.

More and more things begin to arrive on this tiny planet that originates from places that no one has seen nor heard before. Advocates, Objectors, and people that harbor secrets of their own began to oppose one another in the dark for their ideals.
A woman depicted in an oil painting seems to be the key to everything that is happening. She causes people to go insane but also gives people hope …… The men and women serving as a Herald, can they still smile?

42794.synopsis:
My first love ended when my childhood friend and girlfriend, Sorane Takasaki, said, “Let’s break up….”
It was Todo, the ace striker on the same soccer team, who stole my girlfriend away from me.
Yuma Munagata, a second-year high school student, is an inconspicuous boy with a gloomy personality.
But there were two special things about him. First, he has a beautiful childhood friend, Sorane Takasaki, and second, he is actually a foreigner.
Since he was a returnee, he was very assertive and was ignored by the people around him.

Shiranui is half Russian, and like Yuma, is a foreigner who has returned to Japan. In order to change their difficult lives, the teacher in charge of their class orders them to join a special club, the Public Morals Club.

“So if we were to substitute it, it would be with blood, saliva, or tears.”
Calthus whispered softly.
“When you’re mentally ready, then we’ll try it.”
Uh… So.
Let me summarize what he just said…
‘Forcing a kiss with someone you don’t even love is cruel, so you’re saying you won’t force it?’
What kind of nonsense is that.
Do you think I’m someone who would weigh ‘the purity of your snout’ and ‘your life’?
“Open your mouth.”
If you think kissing will make you better, then just kiss me.
Why are you talking so much?

110890.synopsis:
During her university years, Yue Su acted on impulse and picked up a man.
He had amnesia, a wild figure, and stunning looks.
Later, the amnesiac man became her boyfriend.
Yue Su fell deeply in love with him, but then he regained his memory — and turned out to be the crown prince of the prestigious Fu family in Beijing’s elite circle.
He remembered everyone, everyone except her.
On a snowy night, Yue Su stood downstairs all night, just to catch a glimpse of him, but instead, she met his fiancée.
Heartbroken and disillusioned, her career stalling, Yue Su decisively withdrew from the entertainment industry and had her child.
Four years later, she brought her child onto a reality show — only to reunite with him on the program.
The man was cold and distant, treating another woman’s child like a precious treasure.
The whole internet was shipping him with a trending starlet, mocking Yue Su for overestimating herself.
Until one day after the show ended, paparazzi captured —
The noble and untouchable heir of the Fu family cornering Yue Su in a corner,
Lowering his head humbly, begging for her forgiveness.
*
Yao Yao had a dream.
When she woke up, she was shocked — her mother was actually the pregnant-runaway villainess in a CEO romance novel!
She asked Little Fatty, “What’s a villainess?”
Little Fatty replied, “The evil stepmother in Snow White is a villainess.”
Yao Yao asked, “Then what about the villainess’s daughter?”
Little Fatty answered, “That’s a cannon fodder.”
Yao Yao didn’t want to become cannon fodder, so she urged her mother to work hard and make money.
But during a variety show, she unexpectedly ran into her cheap biological father.
The cheap dad looked very rich.
Yao Yao asked, “Uncle, when you die, can you give me your watch?”
Fu Xijin replied, “I can give it to you even if I don’t die.”
Yao Yao said, “Better wait until you die to give it to me.”
Fu Xijin smiled — his little cotton-padded jacket wasn’t too drafty after all.
Yao Yao then asked, “Can you die tomorrow and give it to me?”
Fu Xijin: “…”
associated_names: 惊呆！我亲妈竟是带球跑女配！

112426.synopsis:
Late spring. The streets were unusually soaked and lively.
 Seohee, worn out and emotionally parched from her parents’ contempt and neglect, gets entangled with a playboy notorious for his messy private life.
“Ah… I didn’t plan to take it this far.”
 “……”
 “But I guess I’ll be staying the night.”
A man who switches seamlessly between kindness and rudeness.
 A man who speaks lightly of love.
 A man who mocks fairy tales as mere illusions — Joo Taebaek.
Wrapped in all things bold and flashy, he crashes into Seohee like a raging wave, shaking her to the core.
“Okay. I’ll keep your secret.”
 “…Really?”
 “But only if you let me have one wild round.”
A messy fling.
 A fleeting thrill.
“You don’t need to overthink it.”
She thought that if she assimilated into his world, she might at least receive a fragment of fake love.
 So, she willingly threw herself into a fleeting game of fire.
**
Was she crazy? Who on earth taught her how to seduce a man like this?
“Um… So, it’s over now, right?”
Seohee tilted her head slightly as she looked at the completely dazed Taebaek.
“I need to leave before midnight.”
Who really got caught in the flames?

112682.synopsis:
The young girl broke out of her shell.
She had horns on her head and a tail behind her—
a natural enemy of humans,
a being humans feared.
“Wait a minute… why am I the only one with a tail?”
Sensing something was off, I turned and ran—
only to be captured by the dragon girl.
“Are you my mom?”
“No, I picked you up.”
“Then you… ah—what are you doing!?”
“Just saying hi.”
“That’s not… how you say hi!”
associated_names: 变成幼龙姬的我被龙女宠爱

114474.synopsis:
“To think I’d be thrown into this tr*sh heap of a world!”
The Chronicles of the Seven-Colored World — a series that ran for over 800 episodes and earned its fair share of curses from readers. A batsh*t crazy world full of absurd plot twists, endlessly evolving monsters, and heroines who try to kill the protagonist at every turn.
“And I got reincarnated into this mess?”
I’ve ended up as a nobody named Rudian, a total background character. But with a freaky eyeball monster I happened to pick up, Adi, and a demonic sword called Diablo by my side.
associated_names: Stuck in a Glitch Novel as an Extra
Trapped in a Crazy World as an Extra

114986.synopsis:
[System + Campus Belle + Revenge + Underdog’s Triumph + Wish Fulfillment + Pursuit Turned Desperation] 
Top-tier player Zhou Yi died and was reborn into the body of a hopeless simp who shared his name.
His first love callously dumped him for a rich heir, his childhood sweetheart saw him as an embarrassment, the ice-cold campus beauty looked down on him—every woman he ever loved treated him like a pathetic doormat.
But later, his ex came crawling back in tears: “Yi, I was wrong. Please take me back.”
His childhood sweetheart became hopelessly devoted: “Yi, just one more glance from you is all I ask.”
The aloof campus belle blushed as she handed him a love letter: “Zhou Yi, I was blind before. Will you accept my feelings?”
To all of them, Zhou Yi just smiled. “Sorry, too late. I’m done with love.”
Oh, and he also gained a system—every time he earned a woman’s affection, his looks improved and his bank account grew. Soon, he became the nation’s most eligible bachelor, with socialites and heiresses begging for his attention…
associated_names: 海王魂穿舔狗：开局拿下美艳女神

118314.synopsis:
In a world besieged by gates and demonic beasts, Hunters risk their lives daily, returning from the battlefield physically and mentally exhausted. For Jeongwoo, an ordinary man who never awakened any superhuman abilities, his battlefield was different: raising his precious four-year-old daughter, Se-ah, alone in a cramped, dark semi-basement after the tragic loss of his wife. His only dream is their happiness. When they finally move into a cozy two-story building to open “Seon-ah’s Restaurant”—named lovingly after his late wife—they create a sanctuary isolated from the harsh realities of the outside world.
The restaurant’s very first customer is a weary Hunter who discovers that Jeongwoo’s cooking is nothing short of miraculous. It’s not just the perfect harmony of flavors, it’s the warmth of a home-cooked meal and the adorable enthusiasm of little Se-ah, who serves food from her special step-stool chair. As word quietly spreads of a place where tired souls can find peace and a taste of home, Jeongwoo and Se-ah might just discover that the greatest superpower isn’t fighting monsters, but healing hearts one meal at a time.

120106.synopsis:
Tenor Schwarnen.
He was the dog of the Duchy of Schwarnen. The loyal watchdog of the Duke of Schwarnen. Nothing more, nothing less.
The one who received the respect and admiration of the people was always his elder brother—Tenor was merely the obedient servant of the ruling duke.
Then, the Duke’s order came down to him.
‘On my behalf, I want you to marry Regina, the sole candidate for the throne from the five royal houses of Latouanne.’
A loveless marriage.
Tenor simply followed his brother’s command and took Regina as his wife.
“Let’s talk for a bit today. Tenor.”
“I am busy. The cartel is always busy. Even more so at night.”
“Then when will we ever…?”
“If you’re so insistent, can’t you simply wait for me until I return?”
A marriage as cold as the winter wind.
Ah… this wasn’t what Regina had hoped for.
She had dreamed of a happy marriage—how foolish she’d been. The marriage to Schwanen was born of her own selfish desire—her pure, selfish desire to become his wife simply because she liked him so much.
But as she stared into Tenor’s cold, scornful eyes, Regina began to wither.
So, she decided to turn back time using the hidden power of the House of Flona.
With the flower language of : a new beginning.
If she ever went back in time, she swore she’d never marry into the Schwarnen family.
Or so she thought.
“… Why are you just staring blankly?”
“Pardon?”
“I’ll leave and sleep elsewhere.”
No way!
Of all the nights, I’ve returned to our wedding night!

120362.synopsis:
Driven by circumstances and with no other choice, Qiu Cheng could only find himself a sponsor.
He was clever from a young age, resilient, and extremely perceptive. 
In the end, he found a man that others wouldn’t even dare to consider.
Ever since Qiu Cheng met Mu Xingtian, his debts were paid off, he had the money to treat his relatives’ illnesses, and the troublesome harassers around him disappeared. 
He even started filming dramas and participating in variety shows, gaining access to various resources, and those resources only got better and better. 
Onlookers secretly gritted their teeth, feeling that Qiu Cheng definitely wouldn’t have it good for long; once that man got tired of him, he would be cast back to his original state. 
Little did they know, what Qiu Cheng and that man were playing at was genuine sincerity.
攀附 (Pānfù) is a Chinese metaphor for relying on powerful people in order to gain some kind of benefit (clinging onto someone to climb up).

120874.synopsis:
Jiang Tang became bound to a quick-transmigration system. His mission? Travel to different worlds and save the beautiful, strong, and miserable!  ”That’s fine, but…” Jiang Tang’s expression was subtle, “Can’t I be a normal human?”  The system responded solemnly: “Unfortunately not, your mission target’s XP is rather strange.”
World One – The Picky Evil Spirit and His “Poor Little” Sacrifice:  Facing the sinister eyes of the mission target, Jiang Tang: “Tong, what if he wants my life? He looks like he’ll eat me alive.”  System: “…Wake up, the evil spirit is you.”  Some time later, Jiang Tang felt the mission target’s breath on his ear as he slipped into a daze: “So, was this sacrifice’s ‘quality’ satisfactory?”  
World Two – The Peerless Incubus and His Depressed Track-Student Roommate:  The system declared with full confidence, “Don’t worry, host! This time, the mission target is steel straight!”  With Jiang Tang’s help, the mission target finally returned to the peak of his athletic career, but pulled him into his arms at night, huskily probing: “Aside from me, how many people have embraced you like this?”  
World Three – AI Butler and His Unlearned Young Master:  Jiang Tang was full of worries. “Tong, this time…”  The system patted its chest and guaranteed: “AI and humans are reproductively isolated, there will be no more accidents!”  Reassured, Jiang Tang put his mind at ease, worked diligently, and urged the mission target to complete his counterattack. Yet… ”Please stop creating R-rated videos featuring artificial intelligence, thank you.”  
The next world, Jiang Tang: “Tong—”
 The system’s face collapsed. “Host, for the mission, some sacrifices are inevitable.”  Jiang Tang: “…”  
—World 4: Gentle Veteran Demon Hunter x  Obsessive Vampire
—World 5: Cold and Ascetic Buddhist Monk x Charming Snake Demon  
—World 6: Longing-for-connection Mysophobic and Lonely Film Emperor x Innocent and Withdrawn Little Bunny 
—World 7: Split-personality Researcher x Siren
—World 8: Infinite Flow Player x Roleplay-addicted Infinite Flow NPC 
*Fishing beauty shou vs willingly hooked gong 
* 1v1, gongs are the same person, super sweet double first love, it’s worth investing (wink) 
*Mainly from the shou’s perspective, but the gong’s  is written sometimes for the progression of the novel
associated_names: I Became a Non-Human Again [Quick Wear]
Yet Again, I’m Not Human [Quick Transmigration]
我又穿成了非人類[快穿]

123434.synopsis:
Exploring the unknown, pursuing truth, transcending life and death, and controlling minds, this is what it means to be a wizard.
In a wizarding world heavily reliant on resources, transmigrator Locke Augustine uses his cheat, the Synthesis Cube, to transform low-grade materials into high-grade ones. He embarks on a path toward truth through breeding, potion-making, alchemy, and more, developing new magical plants, potions, and bloodlines.
“I care not for the fate of this world or the lives of strangers within it. But as wizards, we must pioneer all, conquer all, and forever advance toward the unknown.”

163114.synopsis:
【Shura Scenario】+【Bloodbath】+【Invincible】+【Superpowers】+【Lighthearted】+【(Not) Yandere (Only)?】
Planner: Witch is a next-gen masterpiece about romance and raising sims. Please take good care of every magical girl!
Jiang Lin: Got it. As a pro at screwing people over, I’m best at turning the honeymoon phase into a tragedy—so they’ll regret it for the rest of their lives!
To purify evil spirits for the shrine maiden, he lied and claimed betrayal, then went alone to his death;
To give the puppet a second life, he willingly let himself be misunderstood as a control freak;
For the saintess’s flawless world, he used his own body to filter out every last stain of filth;
……
“Everything is for raising the highest-quality witch.”
Jiang Lin had a great time playing.
Until he got transported into the game.
One witch after another came knocking.
Jiang Lin: Serious question—how do I avoid a stabbed-to-death ending?
—Maybe the answer is to let them start fighting each other first.
associated_names: 什么叫前女友全是魔女？

171306.synopsis:
Fang Jiyao is the cherished daughter of the Minister of Revenue’s household — gentle, quiet, and unassuming to a fault. Yet unbeknownst to anyone, she possesses a singular gift: the ability to control her own dreams.
One night, a young man wanders into her dreamscape.
Handsome and noble in bearing, with cool, refined features — he is precisely the manner of man she finds pleasing. And so, in a moment of weakness she cannot quite bring herself to regret, she pins him down within the dream, and what follows is tender and intoxicating.
At a palace banquet, Jiyao catches sight of the Son of Heaven seated in the place of highest honor — and goes cold. It is him. Her dream lover.
The Emperor’s cruelty is known to all beneath the heavens.
Jiyao’s heart hammers in her chest. She does not dare make a sound, and can only console herself in silence: It was only a dream. No one knows she once defiled the Emperor within it. She is still, outwardly, a composed and virtuous young lady of good family.
What she does not notice is that the moment the Emperor’s gaze falls upon her, he crushes the delicate silver cup in his hand.
The young Emperor’s lips curve into the faintest smile.
Good. I’ve finally found you in the flesh.
associated_names: Every Night, The Tyrant Invades My Dreams

176170.synopsis:
Duan Yanchu owns a building that’s currently under construction.
One day, bored out of his mind, he picked up a pair of binoculars and idly looked over at the construction site across the street. That’s when he saw a tall, dark-skinned young man, drenched in sweat as he carried bricks under the blazing sun.
From that moment on, watching the site through his binoculars became his daily pastime.
Later, he found out the young man was only nineteen—well-built, strikingly attractive in a raw, physical way. Training him into a personal bodyguard didn’t sound like a bad idea.
After all, he was just a beta. Nothing serious—just a bit of fun.

178474.synopsis: Transmigrating to the Douluo Continent, I awaken my Spirit Eye Martial Soul. I refuse to join Shrek Academy, nor worship the old gods; I forge my own path at Canghui Academy. With the Eye of Truth, I see through all illusions; with the Heart of Order, I accept no divine position. I seize opportunities destined by fate, oppose the teachings of false gods, and, with neutrality, gather like-minded friends. From the pinnacle of the continent to the pinnacle of the God Realm, I inherit no one’s divine position—I create my own, open a new world, and define my own order.

187434.synopsis:
Obsessively devoted protagonist × Reincarnated villainous noble. What truth lies behind this terrifyingly intense love…?
I reincarnated as Sataria, the villainous young lord of a dark, revenge-themed manga. Sataria is destined to be the final boss—the ultimate obstacle standing in the protagonist’s way, meant to be brutally struck down at the climax of his vengeance.
Upon realizing my grim fate, my first instinct is to run. However, I can’t turn a blind eye to the atrocities of my new family; the House of Count Lactofer is a hopelessly corrupt lineage that doesn’t even treat people as human beings. If I flee, the body count will only rise. Thus, I make my decision: I will protect as many innocent lives as possible while steering my own house toward its absolute ruin, exactly as the original storyline dictates.
But then, the unexpected happens. The protagonist—the revenge-driven demon Arven, whom I wasn’t supposed to meet until much later—somehow appears right in front of me as a candidate to become my exclusive servant. As a victim of the Lactofer family’s cruelty, he was treated worse than a s*ave and should despise my bloodline more than anyone else in the world.
Yet, locking his eyes onto mine with a gaze brimming with a terrifying, feverish heat, he speaks words I never anticipated:
“Make me yours.”
associated_names: ラスボス系悪役令息が望むのは、原作通りの没落ルート

201258.synopsis:
Transported to another world filled with sorcery, magical beasts, and ancient gods.
Amidst countless bloodline wizards and a myriad of bizarre races, Luna inherits the destiny of the ‘Silver Moon’, becoming a descendant of the Silver Moon.
The Moon Witch has decided to embark on her journey!

207402.synopsis:
At the Sect Assembly, I casually pulled an ancient zither from my robe.
The entire venue fell silent.
Eldest Senior Brother asked in a trembling voice, “Is that… the Phoenix-Perch Zither that has been missing for a hundred years?”
Remaining unfazed, I casually took a hairpin from my hair.
Eldest Senior Sister screamed, “That’s the divine artifact, the Qingwu Hairpin!”
Later, the entire cultivation world was abuzz with rumors that Lin Zhiyue possessed a portable abode filled with countless ancient spiritual tools and even divine artifacts.
Only Lin Zhiyue knew that these outfits were just fashions provided by her system.
Today she wanted to wear Mist-shrouded Verdure; tomorrow, she would wear Flowing Fire and Scarlet Stars. As for the day after—
The damn system suddenly popped up a window: [The limited-time card pool “Mystical Lady of the Nine Heavens” is now open! Collect the full set to unlock flying special effects. Don’t miss out!] 
I looked at the 48 pieces in the pool, along with the facial makeup and hairstyles that required spending money, and fell into deep thought.
